title: One outsider can use up the day's spoken messages for every member, and get free voice-to-text
what: The Speak button sends the clip to MettleUp's voice box, which needs no sign-in. Its limits are 20 clips a day per made-up install id, 60 per internet address, and 1,000 a day shared by everyone. On IPv6 the per-address limit counts the full address, so one phone or home can change address without end (the typed help box already closes this gap; the voice box does not). A script can send 1,000 clips of any sound, get the text back each time, and after that every member who taps Speak is told they have spoken a lot today.
expected: The voice box counts addresses the same way as the help box, ties clips to a gym member where it can, and a member who has not used their own share is never refused because of someone else.
fix_line: Count voice clips by the same address rule as the help box, and give signed-in gym members their own share outside the shared cap
